story: A progressive filly for digital ownership with Evolution Stables marketplace storytelling.

Prudentia is a New Zealand-bred four-year-old mare by Proisir, trained from Matamata by Lance O'Sullivan and Andrew Scott at Wexford Stables. She has already recorded a maiden victory and performed across a range of distances and track conditions.

Her win came over 1400 metres at Tauranga, where she handled testing Heavy conditions to score decisively. Since breaking her maiden, she has stepped into Rating 65 Benchmark company, continuing her preparation against stronger opposition. Her race record reflects early progression through maiden grade and exposure to open competition within New Zealand's domestic programme.
pedigree: Mare / Proisir (AUS) x Little Bit Irish (NZ)

story:
Hottathanafantasy is a promising two-year-old filly from New Zealand, combining a high-class international pedigree with the expert guidance of Hall of Fame trainer Lance O'Sullivan. She represents an exceptional opportunity to enter the world of New Zealand racing at its highest level.

Currently in her first year of racing preparation, she shows all the physical traits of a high-performance athlete ready to make her mark on the New Zealand turf. Her natural athleticism and blue-chip bloodlines reflect both her high ceiling and the regard in which she is held by the Wexford Stables team.

This offering provides a rare entry point into a professionally managed racing career from day one.

I Stole A Manolo is a New Zealand-bred two-year-old filly by the Group 1 winning miler Satono Aladdin, trained from Matamata by Lance O'Sullivan and Andrew Scott. Coming from a deep New Zealand maternal line with a pedigree designed for speed and class, she is an exciting addition to the Wexford Stables roster.

A bay filly that possesses real presence and a strong, correct moving action. Born on August 30, 2023, she is a daughter of the sensational sire Satono Aladdin, who has taken the New Zealand breeding scene by storm with his first crops.

She is out of the Jimmy Choux mare Canuhandleajandal, a family noted for its toughness and performance. Currently in the early stages of her racing education at the world-class Matamata facilities, she is being carefully prepared to follow in the footsteps of Wexford's many Group 1 champions.

story:
A 2YO bay filly by Group 1 sire Turn Me Loose out of the Group 2-winning mare Yearn, currently in early education with Stephen Gray at Copper Belt Lodge, Palmerston North.

This filly combines a proven Group 1 sire line with a multiple-stakes-performed dam. Turn Me Loose has already produced a Group 1 winner (Licketysplit) and 89 winners from his first crops. Yearn was a high-class race mare with 7 wins and nearly $340,000 in prizemoney, including the Group 2 Auckland Thoroughbred Breeders Stakes and placings in the Group 1 Thorndon Mile and Group 2 Rich Hill Mile.

Bred by C W Kwok and offered at the 2025 Karaka National Yearling Sales Series (Lot 413, account Windsor Park Stud) before being withdrawn — retained for racing rather than sale. The filly is registered on the NZTR Stud Book with full identification (microchip, brands, DNA typing).
pedigree: Filly / Turn Me Loose (NZ) x Yearn (NZ)
